vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A man, maybe 20s about A person, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
👂 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek "Hey — come here. You should hear this."

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Ingrid about A person, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
You catch fragments by the fire — Grayson telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about themself. The retelling is already better than the event.
🍲 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek eats from the pantry.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
🍲 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.

👀 the woman in her 40s, with a scarred cheek was talking about home — then stopped mid-sentence, recalibrated, and said "Denver" just a fraction too deliberately. Whatever home is, it isn't where that sentence started.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek).
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
🍲 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek eats quiet by the fire, scraping the bowl clean with their thumb.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 40s, with a scarred cheek taught the man in his 20s Field Dressing.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Ingrid about Grayson. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek came back with 461 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 231 kcal in, 230 kcal eaten at the fire.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A man, maybe 40s, with a limp about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — Aroha telling Emma about A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.

🔥 The fire settles. Mateo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A shadow moving wrong against the sun — I put it down today." "A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you." "It missed. It hits the dirt hard — wings splayed, vulnerable. Kill it now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the man in his 60s says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." the woman in her 40s, with a scarred cheek breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what ar
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Emma about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
🍲 A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.

A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a soft green glow under the water. Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp."
📓 Codex: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — jotted down what they said. Filed.
🛡️ Luis, Patrick, Aisana and Aroha met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Luis, Patrick, Aisana, Aroha are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Grayson, Patrick, Aisana, Aroha and Emma met them at the door — 5 put down. Grayson, Patrick, Aisana, Aroha, Emma are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Patrick just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Grayson just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aisana, Aroha, Emma and Ingrid met them at the door — 4 put down. Aisana, Aroha, Emma, Ingrid are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lucas just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
